title: Transformation on encoded queries
statement: Let $f$ map bit strings to bit strings, let $x$ be a bit string, and let $i$ be a natural number. Applying the transformation to the encoding of $(x,\operatorname{bin}(i))$ returns the encoding of $(f(x),\operatorname{bin}(i))$, where $\operatorname{bin}(i)$ is the binary expansion of $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from bit strings to bit strings
